Pruning means stopping exploration early when you can prove the current branch cannot meet the goal.

Use an observable state container and replace immutable lists, or use an appropriate snapshot state collection. remember itself does not handle permanent saving.

ui.notNecessarilyAModelSTokenizationSpli:
Not necessarily. A model's tokenization splits text into chunks of different sizes, and language, symbols, and content all affect the token count.

ui.notNecessarilyCountTheActualNumberOfE:

If the inner pointer only moves forward and moves at most n times overall, the total cost may be O(n).
ui.itDoesNotGuaranteeThatAutomaticallyRe:

ui.differentContextsCareAboutDifferentRu:

An aggregate protects a set of business invariants, and its boundary affects transaction design.
ui.differentSymptomsNeedDifferentEvidenc:

First reproduce the issue reliably, then collect the matching view. One rebuild does not equal a performance problem.
ui.noWebPagesDocumentsAndToolResultsAre:

External content may try to induce leaks or unauthorized actions, so isolate trust boundaries, limit tool permissions, and verify critical actions.
ui.notRequiredCQRSSeparatesTheReadModelF:
Not required. CQRS separates the read model from the write model; Event Sourcing uses events as the authoritative history of state. They can be used independently.
When combined, you still need to handle read model update delays, event versions, and replay side effects.
ui.notRequiredSSEIsSuitableForSendingTex:
Not required. SSE is suitable for sending text events from the server to the browser; WebSocket supports two-way communication and fits frequent bidirectional messages.
Both need handling for disconnects, reconnects, authentication, and resource cleanup. Choose based on communication direction and environment constraints.
ui.noOnTypicalPagesPromiseCallbacksRunOn:

Long synchronous computation or continuously appending microtasks can still block page responsiveness; use a Worker or chunked processing when needed.
ui.noNoCacheAllowsStorageButUsuallyRequi:

ui.noAsyncAwaitItselfDoesNotMoveSynchron:

ui.noTTLOnlyLimitsHowLongSomeStale:

ui.noItMainlyAffectsSamplingRandomnessAn:

ui.maintainAMinHeapOfSizeKThe:

The overall cost is usually O(n log K). If the final output must be ordered, an extra sort is needed.
